from tools import search_flights, search_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached restaurant results
cached_restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Search for flights
flights_result = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="St. Louis",
    departure_date=["2025-05-16", "2025-05-22"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save flights to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights", value=flights_result)

# Search for hotels
hotels_result = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    neighborhood=["Downtown"],
    checkin_date=["2025-05-16", "2025-05-22"],
    checkout_date=["2025-05-25"],
    budget=70,
    free_parking=True
)

# Save hotels to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels_result)

# Filter restaurants based on dietary restrictions and cuisine
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=cached_restaurants,
    cuisine=["Chinese"],
    has_dairy_allergy_options=True
)

# Save filtered restaurants to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)
